headline: Store wallet deductions, clear purchase receipts, and larger booster icons

changes.title: Nut and Gem purchases now show their exact wallet deductions
changes.detail: Confirmed purchases of lives, extra moves, boosters, and gravity-hold tools display the currency balance before and after payment. The shop and top currency counters refresh immediately, and deductions are saved.

changes.title: Large Golden Nut and Gem balances are protected
changes.detail: Booster and hold-tool purchases use the full stored wallet balance instead of a smaller inventory cap, while elemental-trial rewards preserve existing large balances when adding prizes.

changes.title: Booster illustrations fill their existing button faces
changes.detail: In-level power-up artwork is enlarged within the unchanged booster button grid, with stock counts over the art instead of tiny icons surrounded by oversized button framing.
